messages:
carla_pm: Quick follow-up from the postmortem — assigning remediation owners, RACI, and timelines. Please ack and add/update Jira tickets if anything is missing. Summary doc: https://redwood.app/pm/postmorts/RED-INC-2026

Action items (initial):
- RED-4012 — Automate gen-serve rollback (Owner: ben_g) — tentative due 2026-03-12
- RED-4017 — Improve cache eviction alerting + runbook (Owner: dmitri_sre) — tentative due 2026-03-15
- RED-4025 — Add e2e tests for import pipeline (Owner: ben_g / subtask) — tentative due 2026-03-19
- RED-4030 — Handoff / oncall playbook updates (Owner: alice_w) — tentative due 2026-03-11

RACI: Responsible = owner, Accountable = product (carla_pm), Consulted = SRE/eng, Informed = support/docs. Please reply with ack + actual due date.

ben_g: Ack — I'll take RED-4012 (rollback automation). ETA Fri 2026-03-12. Will open the subtask for e2e and link it.

dmitri_sre: Taking RED-4017. I'll add runbook entry and wire up alert thresholds. Putting ETA 2026-03-15. I'll also look into root cause pattern for cache pressure.

alice_w: Acked. I'll own the handoff docs and schedule the 30m rotate/hand-off with oncall. Will add ops-oncall as watcher on tickets.

oncall-bot: Reminder: next on-call handover scheduled Tue 2026-03-09 09:00 UTC. Use /handover to submit notes and include links to tickets.

ben_g: Quick note — creating and linking tickets now. Command I used:
```
jira create --project RED --summary "Automate rollback for gen-serve" --labels postmortem --assignee ben_g --due 2026-03-12
jira link RED-4012 RED-INC-2026
```

carla_pm: Nice. When you create tickets, please add this RACI note in the ticket description: Responsible=owner, Accountable=carla_pm, Consulted=sre, Informed=support. Also add the postmortem tag and link to the master tracker. I'll tick off items here once tickets have due dates. If timelines slip, flag in this thread so we can re-prioritize.

dmitri_sre: Also flagging a recurring pattern — cache pressure spikes after large batch imports. I'll open an RFC in docs/architecture and link it to RED-4017 so we can track longer-term mitigations. cc @carla_pm @alice_w

alice_w: Thanks — I'll schedule the quick handoff meeting for Mon 2026-03-08 15:00 UTC and invite owners + oncall. Putting a placeholder in the calendar now.

ben_g: Done: created RED-4012 and subtask RED-4050 for e2e. Linked and added watchers (ops-oncall, carla_pm). Jira link: https://jira.redwood.ai/browse/RED-4012

carla_pm: :thumbsup: Thanks everyone. We'll close this thread after: 1) tickets have due dates 2) tracker updated and 3) handoff scheduled. I'll run a 2-week check-in in #postmortem-checks to verify regressions or recurring patterns.
